title: taraxacum holmenianum
intro: Taraxacum holmenianum, commonly known as Holmen's dandelion, is a species of flowering plant in the dandelion genus. It is a perennial plant with medicinal properties, traditionally used to support digestive health and relieve various gastrointestinal issues. The health benefits of Taraxacum holmenianum include reducing inflammation, soothing digestive discomfort, and promoting antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and hepatoprotective effects.
